meta.title: EDUGOGO — Institution Setup
meta.description: Institution configuration form for the EDUGOGO platform.

hero.subtitle: Complete this form to start configuring your virtual campus. The process takes about 10–15 minutes and our team will take care of the rest.

1.title: Institution Information
1.desc: Basic identification details for your institution.

2.title: Contact Information
2.desc: Communication channels for students and prospects.

3.title: Director & Location
3.desc: Legal representative information and institution headquarters.

4.title: Visual Identity & Brand
4.desc: Logos, favicon and color identity for your institution.

5.title: Social Media & Websites
5.desc: URLs for your institution's digital presence.

6.title: Documents & Technical Setup
6.desc: Legal files, legal text and integration tokens.

intro.title: Institution Setup Form
intro.description: We'll guide you through 6 sections to configure your institution's virtual campus on EDUGOGO. The process takes 10–15 minutes and you can switch languages anytime without losing your progress.

common.naHint: If you don't have this information or it doesn't apply, type N/A.
common.dimensionWarningTemplate: Your image is {width}×{height}px. For best results, we recommend {recWidth}×{recHeight}px.
common.colorPickerLabel: Click the color circle to open the picker.

sections.logosDesc: Provide public URLs to your image files (Google Drive, Dropbox, AWS S3, etc.). Regular logos are previewed on a white background; negative logos on a dark background.
sections.documentsDesc: Upload your files in PDF format.
sections.tokensDesc: Tokens are sensitive credentials. They are stored securely and encrypted. Do not share this form with unauthorized people.

email_address.label: Responsible person's email
email_address.hint: This email will receive a copy of the submitted configuration.

legal_name.label: Legal name
legal_name.hint: Legal name exactly as it appears on official documents.

domain_mask.label: Domain mask
domain_mask.hint: Custom domain for the virtual campus.

institution_code.label: Institution code
institution_code.hint: Unique code assigned by EDUGOGO or your regulatory body.

license_number.label: Operating license number
license_number.hint: Official number from your regulatory body.

admissions_whatsapp.label: Admissions WhatsApp
admissions_whatsapp.hint: Full number with country code, no spaces or dashes.

operations_email.label: Operations email
operations_email.hint: All automated communications to students will be sent from this email.

director_signature.label: Director's signature
director_signature.hint: Image of the director/principal's signature for documents and certificates.

address.label: Address
address.placeholder: e.g. 45 Main St, Education Tower Building

favicon_url.label: Favicon
favicon_url.hint: Small icon that appears in the browser tab (32×32px).

logo_url.label: Logo (no tagline)
logo_url.hint: Main logo on a light background, no tagline (transparent PNG).

logo_small_url.label: Icon / Small logo
logo_small_url.hint: Brand icon or symbol without text.

logo_small_negative_url.label: Negative icon
logo_small_negative_url.hint: Light version of the icon for dark backgrounds.

logo_full_url.label: Full logo (with tagline)
logo_full_url.hint: Logo including tagline or institution name.

logo_full_negative_url.label: Negative full logo
logo_full_negative_url.hint: Negative version of the full logo for dark backgrounds.

logo_email_pdf.label: Logo for emails & PDFs
logo_email_pdf.hint: This logo will be used in the emails and PDFs generated by the system. We recommend a rectangular logo (300×160px, PNG or JPEG format).

url_helpdesk.label: Help desk URL
url_helpdesk.hint: Portal where students can create support tickets.

url_scholarships.label: Scholarships / partnerships page
url_scholarships.hint: Page where organizations can sponsor students.

url_philosophy.label: Educational philosophy
url_philosophy.hint: Page describing your educational model and philosophy.

footer_description.label: Short description
footer_description.placeholder: We are an educational institution committed to training excellent professionals...
footer_description.hint: Text that will appear in the virtual campus footer.

license_doc.label: Operating license
license_doc.hint: Official document certifying the institution's operation.

student_manual.label: Student handbook
student_manual.hint: Guide to rules, rights and processes for students.

terms_doc.label: Terms & Conditions (PDF)
terms_doc.hint: Upload your institution's Terms & Conditions document as a PDF.

privacy_doc.label: Privacy Policy (PDF)
privacy_doc.hint: Upload your institution's Privacy Policy document as a PDF.

token_helpdesk.label: Helpdesk token
token_helpdesk.hint: API key or token for your ticketing system (e.g. Freshdesk, Zendesk).

token_paypal.label: PayPal token
token_paypal.hint: Client ID of your PayPal application (for online payments).

token_stripe.label: Stripe token
token_stripe.hint: Stripe publishable key (starts with pk_live_ or pk_test_).

agreeTerms.label: I confirm that all the information provided is true and that I am authorized to submit this data on behalf of the institution.

legal.termsDesc: These are the rules governing the use of your educational platform: what services you offer, institution and student responsibilities, payment/refund policy and campus usage conditions.
legal.privacyDesc: The legal document explaining how your institution collects, uses and protects the personal data of students and users. It is mandatory in most countries (e.g. GDPR, CCPA).

modal.title: Configuration submitted!
modal.body: We have received {institution}'s information. Our technical team will begin configuring the virtual campus within the next 24–48 business hours.
modal.emailNote: You will receive a confirmation at {email}
modal.error: Could not save to Google Sheets. Please try again or save your draft.

validation.required: This field is required. If it doesn't apply, type N/A.
validation.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address or type N/A.
validation.invalidUrl: Enter a valid URL (e.g. https://example.com) or type N/A.
validation.agreeRequired: You must confirm this statement before submitting the form.
validation.submitError: There was an error submitting the form. Please try again or save your draft.
